decisions.reason: It still fits the firm's compliant document workflow strategy for business and public-sector customers, although the lack of recent visibility raises some portfolio-review risk.

Email and fax conversion remains useful in Germany's legacy-heavy and regulated communication environments, but migration toward newer digital channels makes it more exposed than broader core services.

As a narrow fax optimization feature rather than a core platform service, it is the most likely candidate for rationalization so resources can be shifted to stronger security and workflow development.
Threat protection directly reinforces the firm's secure messaging value proposition and should remain attractive as customers place rising weight on email security and compliance.
